_doc: EDGE CONTROL CENSUS (W0, 20 Sep 2026) — the inventory-driven register of every Online POS control (element id in
resources/views/tenant/pos/index.blade.php) against the Edge cashier page. Consumed by
tests/MySql/EdgeCashierControlCensusHttpMySqlTest.php. States: present = same control, same id on Edge;
equivalent = same capability under another id/text; partial = an Edge counterpart exists but the audit record is
PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED / UI-different in a way that changes what the operator can do; planned = MISSING on Edge,
owned by a workstream (record + workstream REQUIRED); online_required = accepted Cloud-only, `decision` REQUIRED.
Selectors: '#id' (id attribute or a quoted 'id' string in the page script), 'text:…' / 'js:…' (raw substring).
Records reference docs/status/edge-online-vs-edge-screen-audit-2026-09-20.md (A = Team A, R = Team B/C, D = Team D, E = Team E).
A control moving state (a planned selector appearing, a present selector vanishing) FAILS the census until this file is updated:
that is the point — the register can no longer drift from the screen.
